A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SageAttention work. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables and appendices support comparison; v9's additional page reflects reference reflow.

before.justification: v7 reports original kernel throughput, numerical accuracy, downstream model evaluations and ablation results in Section 5 and Appendices A–B.

after.justification: v9 retains these original experimental results, including kernel benchmarks, downstream evaluations and appendix comparisons.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 corrects three arithmetic operations in the written SAGEAttn-B update and normalization procedure. The kernel variants, precision choices, K smoothing, adaptive selection and fusion remain unchanged. This establishes a pseudocode correction, not a change to the implementation used for the experiments.

E1.justification: The language modeling, image/video generation, image classification and visual question answering coverage is unchanged. Section 5.1 and the appendices retain the same datasets, models and scenarios, including Open-Sora visual examples.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain Torch, xformers and FlashAttention2 for speed; quantized FlashAttention3 for accuracy; and AWQ, Q-diffusion and VIDIT-Q in Appendix A. No comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Evaluation metrics, head dimensions, causal/noncausal settings, sequence lengths and hardware settings are retained. Appendix A also preserves the same 256 COCO prompts and reference images, kernel configurations and model specifications.

E4.justification: The smoothing, quantization precision, accumulator precision and adaptive-selection analyses are unchanged, including Tables 1–5, 10–11 and 17–18. The appendix's qualitative image/video comparisons are also retained.

E5.justification: Neither version supplies repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. Their average and worst-layer accuracy summaries use the same reporting practice.

E6.justification: Reported numerical results, throughput plots and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Table 7 retains CogvideoX throughput of 327.57 TOPS and a 2.01x speedup, while Table 8 retains SageAttention's Llama2 WikiText perplexity of 5.824.

T1.justification: Algorithm 1 restores the previous-normalizer multiplier in the running normalizer update, removes the erroneous inverse from running-output rescaling, and adds the inverse for final normalization. These corrections align those expressions with Section 3.1's existing mathematics. No theorem, assumption or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims: accurate plug-and-play quantized attention, approximately 2.1x and 2.7x speedups over FlashAttention2 and xformers, and negligible downstream quality loss.

C2.justification: Explanations of K outliers, errors from quantizing P and V, hardware-dependent acceleration and adaptive selection are retained. Appendix A.6's interpretation of Llama2 activation distributions and potential applicability is unchanged; no substantive limitation is added.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures outside the corrected algorithm arithmetic are unchanged: Appendix A retains hardware, software versions, block sizes, warp/stage settings and data preparation details. Code and example-access information also remains the same.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. Added arXiv identifiers for Hu et al. (2025) and Zhang et al. (2025h) complete existing bibliography entries rather than introduce new references.

P1.justification: Editorial changes are limited to bibliographic metadata, capitalization of Jia Wei's name in one reference, and the version/date margin text. The substantive prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 7 moves from page 9 to page 8, with nearby figures, text and Table 7 repositioned. Reference reflow shifts the appendix start from page 16 to page 17. Figures and tables retain their content and numbering.

improvement.justification: v9 fixes three consequential arithmetic errors in Algorithm 1, making the written procedure more reliable to implement and consistent with Section 3.1's existing recurrence and normalization. The gain is localized: experimental evidence, method components and conclusions remain unchanged, and the remaining edits are bibliographic or presentational.
